head_analysis.verdict: Yes, but differentiate it by role, not by GPU. At an equal GPU count a dedicated non-GPU head costs about $908 more and adds about 2.4 stability points; it wins on score at every fleet size tested because a head that also renders shares its CPU, RAM and driver stack with the queue. A GPU in the head looks cheaper per GPU, but it puts the scheduler inside a GPU failure domain; it is worth it only if you want an interactive seat on the same box.
